reads font declarations and embedded variants without interpreting font bytes
lists opaque object activity and font resources through the command SDK

supplementalOriginalTests.assertion: Independent Node crypto name/hash and fixture-byte assertions through SDK command publication.

supplementalOriginalTests.title: requires explicit partial publication and rejects irrelevant selectors and unsafe parts

admits complete manifest output budgets before publishing any file
publishes schemas that validate object and font inventory envelopes
detects a macro relationship even when its content type is generic
returns owned byte copies and rejects accessor selectors without invoking them
enforces an explicit output count ceiling before extraction publication
